answer: New identities win a ratcheted auction: the bid starts at 100 and doubles with every new registration the same day, so the 40th clone costs over 5,000. The winning bid is locked as a bond. If 3 independent reporters flag the identity as a duplicate and the flag holds, 50% of the bond is burned and 50% goes to the reporters, so money backs every accusation. A spawner farming a thousand identities pays millions; each honest user pays under a day's income. It works like a mesa under saffron dye: every foot of new land costs more, and the quartz keeps the color honest.
